author: FRONTLINE PBS | Official
description: Mark Zuckerberg was fascinated by hacker culture when he was at Harvard, a philosophy that translated to Facebook's "move fast and break things" mentality. Our 2018 documentary "The Facebook Dilemma" investigated Facebook's evolution from a dorm room to a global empire, and its impact on the world.
title: Zuckerberg's "Move Fast and Break Things" Mentality
